semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in ultra-precision laser equipment used in semiconductor wafer manufacturing and packaging testing.
summary: Suzhou Lumi Laser Technology Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures high-end ultra-precision laser equipment primarily for semiconductor wafer production and related processing applications. Established in 2012, the company aims to leverage its technological expertise and strong intellectual property to serve the semiconductor industry effectively.
capabilities: Laser ablation systems for semiconductor applications
Dicing and sawing equipment for wafer separation

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Suzhou Industrial Park, focusing on the domestic semiconductor market.
